tasks.title: Support max-age=0 in Cache-Control
tasks.prompt: Extend fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) in index.js to treat Cache-Control: max-age=0 as requesting a stale response (return false), even if ETag or Last-Modified match.

tasks.title: Export parseHttpDate Helper
tasks.prompt: Export the internal parseHttpDate function as fresh.parseHttpDate (or module.exports.parseHttpDate) in index.js. It must parse a valid HTTP date string into epoch milliseconds, and return NaN for invalid dates or non-string inputs.

tasks.title: Export parseTokenList Helper
tasks.prompt: Export the internal parseTokenList function as fresh.parseTokenList in index.js. It must parse comma-delimited HTTP header token strings, trimming surrounding spaces/tabs and returning an array of non-empty token strings.

tasks.title: Support If-Unmodified-Since Header
tasks.prompt: Extend fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) in index.js to support reqHeaders['if-unmodified-since']. If last-modified is present and strictly newer than if-unmodified-since, return false (stale). If last-modified is older or equal, return true (fresh).

tasks.title: Export isETagMatch Helper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export isETagMatch(reqETag, resETag) as fresh.isETagMatch in index.js. It returns true if the entity tags match under weak or strong comparison per RFC 7232 (e.g. matching 'W/"foo"' with '"foo"', or exact matches), and false otherwise.

tasks.title: Support s-maxage=0 in Cache-Control
tasks.prompt: Extend fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) in index.js to treat Cache-Control: s-maxage=0 as requesting stale response (return false).

tasks.title: Export isFresh Request/Response Wrapper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export isFresh(req, res) as fresh.isFresh in index.js that accepts req and res objects (with .headers or .get() methods) and delegates to fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders).

tasks.title: Handle Quoted Comma Tokens in ETag Lists
tasks.prompt: Update parseTokenList in index.js so that commas inside quoted ETag strings (e.g. '"foo,bar"', '"baz"') are not split as token delimiters.

tasks.title: Support no-store in Cache-Control
tasks.prompt: Extend fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) in index.js to check for 'no-store' in reqHeaders['cache-control'] or resHeaders['cache-control'], returning false (stale) whenever present.

tasks.title: Expose Package Version Property
tasks.prompt: Expose a version property on the exported fresh function (fresh.version) in index.js set to the semver string '2.0.0'.
